description_en: The DeleteDbfs operation releases a pay-as-you-go database file system
description_zh: 调用DeleteDbfs释放一个按量付费的数据库文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs delete-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-id dbfs-9aqh1sqfqhc0w500000000 --biz-force false --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDbfs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the DBFS is located. To query the latest list of regions, see DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the DBFS.
The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除数据库文件系统。
默认值：false
parameters.name: force
